investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was left unscheduled for 137–147 seconds with the Kubernetes message "0/6 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector." No VM was ever allocated, so the eval runner never received orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, or remoteState, causing all four required evidence fields to be missing and every contract assertion to go unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted the schedulable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the only two nodes that match the pod's node affinity/selector. Of the 6 nodes in the cluster, 4 do not match the pod's affinity rules at all, and the 2 that do match have no remaining kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity. Preemption cannot help because no lower-priority victims exist on those nodes. As a result, every remote-agent pod is stuck in Unschedulable state and no VM is ever provisioned, which means the eval runner's createAgent call (run-status-probes.mjs line 1885) never returns a VM-backed agent, and the required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) is never written. This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity constraint; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.

investigations.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 6 Nodes
investigations.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment because every pod submitted for remote agent creation was left unscheduled for 137–147 seconds with the Kubernetes message "0/6 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector." No VM was ever allocated, so the eval runner never received orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, or remoteState, causing all four required evidence fields to be missing and every contract assertion to go unmet.
investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted the schedulable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the only two nodes that match the pod's node affinity/selector. Of the 6 nodes in the cluster, 4 do not match the pod's affinity rules at all, and the 2 that do match have no remaining kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity. Preemption cannot help because no lower-priority victims exist on those nodes. As a result, every remote-agent pod is stuck in Unschedulable state and no VM is ever provisioned, which means the eval runner's createAgent call (run-status-probes.mjs line 1885) never returns a VM-backed agent, and the required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) is never written. This is an eval-observed infrastructure capacity constraint; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence.
